criteria.reason: Response is written in Rumantsch Grischun as requested.
Hedged range includes accurate ~60,000 speakers but omits 0.5%/40,000 main-language figure; 80,000 upper bound unsupported.
Claims Romansh has equal official status with German, French, Italian; it is official only in dealings with Romansh speakers.

factual_errors: Claims Romansh is an official language of the Confederation with equal status to German, French and Italian; it is official only when communicating with Romansh speakers.
Says federal authorities must use Romansh in drafting official documents; federal documents are drafted in German, French and Italian.
Upper speaker estimate of 80,000 is unsupported; about 60,000 speak Romansh.
summary: Answers in Rumantsch Grischun with hedged figures including the accurate ~60,000 figure, but falsely claims Romansh has equal official status with German, French and Italian.
